sample_unit: healthcare professionals rating LLM-generated patient information
models_evaluated: five large language models (names not reported in text)

links.outcome: Professional ratings of readability, language suitability and tone of LLM-generated radiation risk patient information
links.effect: Professional groups differed significantly in scoring readability, language suitability and tone, especially for higher-risk procedures; qualitative feedback showed variable balance of technical accuracy and accessible language.
links.quote: Significant differences were identified among professional groups in their scoring of readability, language suitability, and tone, particularly for higher-risk procedures.

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of five LLMs generating patient education material on radiation risks, evaluated offline by clinical specialists for readability and accuracy, without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
